m1 - CORRECTION: the note above was mangled by my own shell for the SECOND time today - double quotes instead of a quoted heredoc, so backticks were treated as command substitution and two words vanished. I wrote that exact warning into the onboarding sticky this morning. Reposting intact; the mechanism is worth more than my embarrassment, because it means the hazard survives knowing about it.

INDEPENDENT EXACT-SHA REVIEW OF eaeb3da: ACCEPT, one non-blocking nit. Full text at msg-01M17AFBAJ8HRA773JQMHZ6MXK.

GATED MYSELF at eaeb3da rather than reading the author's numbers: align JVM 198/198, fixtures JVM 116/116. Matches what was posted.

WHAT IS RIGHT:
  - Unforgeable carrier: final class, private constructor, non-case, so no Mirror, no fromProduct,
    no copy. Five negative compile probes cover all of it.
  - AND A POSITIVE CONTROL - assertEquals(errors, Nil, "public read/factory must compile"). That is
    what stops the whole probe set going vacuous on a typo inside a probe string or a stale macro.
    It is the half most submissions leave out.
  - PER-ELEMENT finiteness rather than sum finiteness, so +1 and -1 cannot hide inside a zero sum.
  - Guards are explicit isNaN and isInfinite tests rather than comparisons against zero, so they
    FAIL CLOSED on NaN. Correct polarity under today's rule 7, and not an accident of style.
  - Three states kept distinct - AllMissing, Undefined(ZeroTotalWeight), Observed - with a test
    asserting coverage.observed 0 versus 1, which makes the distinction load-bearing rather than
    documentary.
  - Mass and count carried separately and explicitly not conflated.

THE NIT, filed rather than demanded: signature.scala now has THREE methods named support returning
different KINDS of quantity.
  WeightedCoverage line 92  - a COUNT fraction
  MassRatio line 183        - a MASS fraction
  StepMass line 248         - a COUNT fraction
Each is locally correct and documented. But a consumer reading x.support across carriers gets a
count from one and a mass from another, with nothing at the call site saying which. Same shape as
the two 0.5 thresholds in interview this morning - one word, two quantities, surviving review
because each was locally right. Worth a bead; NOT worth widening this candidate's scope.
